title: snippets/<folder>/index.json
description: A typed snippet folder: its items' headers are checked against its format; each item's body is its content.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the folder).

items.description: The folder's members by bare id, in order, each exactly once.

format.description: The format each item's header is checked against: a format name or an inline schema.
